adjudicator: Use the same rules and original targets; independently resolve only the supplied coordinate. Do not see the auditor's value or rationale.
auditor: Check all target rows in every domain; challenge exact coordinates only.

rules.PAIR_RULE: Match exact study, condition and outcome; do not change identities.
rules.SD_RULE: Extract a standard deviation, not a standard error.
rules.SOURCE_RULE: Values and their exact source locations must match the report.

scope: Computable pre-g arms only. Missing-data rows remain coded but are not audited in this census. No outcome/moderator besides those in the codebook is introduced.
